references.text: Kadesh is mentioned as the place where the Israelites stayed, the same place from which Moses sent messengers
The Israelites came to the Desert of Kadesh, which was the starting point for sending messengers to Edom
Edom are the descendants of Esau, Jacob's brother; therefore Israel calls him 'your brother'
Esau's genealogy and how he became the ancestor of the Edomites, explaining the brotherhood between Israel and Edom
Moses reminds the people of their encounter with Edom and calls the Edomites 'their brothers, the children of Esau'
The Edomites are called brothers to the Israelites
Jephthah refers to how Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom
Moses told his father-in-law about all the hardships that had befallen them on the journey, using similar wording about their troubles
Jacob sent messengers to his brother Esau in the land of Edom, a parallel to Moses sending messengers to Edom
Obadiah prophesies against Edom and mentions the brotherhood between Edom and Jacob/Israel
